## How to use these materials

::: {.use-grid}
::: {.use-item}
### Before

Complete the [setup guide](setup.qmd). If possible, do this a day before the workshop so there is time to resolve installation problems.
:::

::: {.use-item}
### During

Keep the interactive slides open in your browser and use RStudio for the hands-on exercises. Code examples marked as interactive can also run directly in the browser.
:::

::: {.use-item}
### After

Use the PDFs for quick reference and return to the interactive slides whenever you want to rerun an example. The complete source remains available in the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/jgacnik/r-data-workshop).
:::
:::
:::
